summary:
The Databricks OAuth profile mapping is implemented and registered, and tests are added. I did not run the tests, per your instructions, so they are verified by reading only.

Changes:
- New cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py: DatabricksOauthProfileMapping subclasses the shared base. It declares required fields, secret fields (client_secret, client_id), the airflow-to-dbt mapping (login then extra.client_id; password then extra.client_secret; extra.http_path), and the profile property only. The profile is mapped fields, then profile args, then auth_type oauth, then env-var references for client_secret and client_id. No claim override, no host transform, no method key.
- cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py: imports and exports the new class.
- cosmos/profiles/__init__.py: imports the class, adds it to profile_mappings directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping, and adds it to __all__.
- New tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py: covers the claim check (removing each required input), token-mapping selection for login plus password, OAuth selection for extra credentials, the profile output, profile args not overriding auth_type or secrets, and env-var outputs. It patches BaseHook.get_connection like the token test.

Choices: the OAuth-selection test uses host "https://my_host" to show the host passes through unchanged; the claim-test loop passes "my_databricks_connection" as the connection id instead of the connection object. The test file changed on disk after I wrote it; I read the current content and left it as is.

Nothing was committed.
